summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 15, 2026, announcing the release of its quarterly periodic report as of March 31, 2026, in compliance with Colombian regulatory requirements. The filing is a routine disclosure of financial and operational performance, corporate structure, risk management, and sustainability matters. There are no transaction terms, board recommendations, or special-situation mechanics. This is a standard periodic report with no event-driven elements; no deal terms, activist involvement, or strategic change is indicated.
